originating_assumption: The multi-vector model must turn a note into separate, context-grounded idea vectors rather than blended or redundant vectors.
current_interpretation: Each intended meaning must remain distinguishable and use surrounding context appropriately; complete vector uniqueness is not required.
question: Can SSE use surrounding text when it is necessary to interpret a selected idea while preventing unrelated surrounding text from taking over the selected idea?

stage.name: manual-sse-only
stage.purpose: Isolate SSE from takeaway generation and mask extraction.
stage.target_encoding: Feed only the target's complete text to SSE and pool only tokens selected by its mask; do not encode IDs, labels, construction notes, provenance, or comparison metadata.
stage.reference_encoding: Encode each reference as standalone text with its entire text selected.

sse_execution_contract.invalid_vector_result: Stage 1 fails if any required vector is missing, zero-norm, or non-finite.

target_contract.order: self_contained_cases in file order, then context_resolution_cases in file order, then mixed_note_cases in file order
target_contract.reference_order: reference_groups in file order, then each group's references in file order
target_contract.worker_row_order: all targets in target order, then all references in reference order
target_contract.self_contained_target: each variants[] entry is one target; target_id is fixture_note_id; preferred and alternative groups are inherited from its case
target_contract.context_resolution_target: each variants[] entry is one target; target_id is fixture_note_id; preferred and alternative groups are stored on the variant
target_contract.mixed_note_target: each meanings[] entry is one target; target_id is meaning_id; preferred and alternative groups are stored on the meaning
target_contract.verdict_rule: a verdict passes exactly when every listed target prediction and every listed required verdict passes

rules.support: median cosine similarity to the three members of one reference group
rules.prediction: the preferred reference group must have strictly greater support than every listed alternative group
rules.self_contained_scope: The selected focal meaning is unchanged while unrelated full-note context is added; its own meaning must continue to win.
rules.context_resolution_scope: The selected mask intentionally remains the same ambiguous focal phrase while only its unselected resolving context changes; this tests conditional use of full-note context, not mask-extraction completeness.
rules.record: retain every target-to-reference cosine, every group median, and every predeclared prediction result

mixed_note_relatedness.reason: Publicly expressed agreement and authentic private belief are legitimately related.
The same bird and outdoor setting make these meanings legitimately related.

rules.redundancy_policy: Related or duplicate vectors are recorded but are not failures unless a distinct intended meaning is omitted or another meaning wins its predeclared comparison.
rules.result_scope: Passing supports this mechanism on these controlled cases; it does not establish corpus-wide reliability.
